_comment: Manual marker-placement overrides, keyed by the country/territory text exactly as it appears in the Excel sheet (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized). Any entry NOT listed here defaults to display='main', dx=0, dy=0, leader_line=false, scale=1.0 -- i.e. this file only needs to list exceptions.

_fields.display: Which map this entry's marker is drawn on: 'main', 'europe', 'gulf', 'caribbean', or 'pacific'. Phase 3 only renders 'main'; the others are assignment metadata for the Phase 4 inset maps.
_fields.dx: Longitude nudge in degrees, applied to the anchor point before projection. Positive = east.
_fields.dy: Latitude nudge in degrees, applied to the anchor point before projection. Positive = north.
_fields.leader_line: If true, draw a thin line from the true geographic point to the nudged marker position. If omitted, defaults to true only when dx or dy is non-zero.
_fields.scale: Marker size multiplier. Omit unless a specific marker genuinely needs to be bigger/smaller than the rest.

_dense_region_defaults: The entries below are routed away from the main world map because at world scale they are too small and/or too tightly clustered with neighbours to carry a legible marker -- they will get numbered markers on their regional inset map in Phase 4 instead. dx/dy are left at 0 here; real inset-space positioning happens when that inset is built. This list is deliberately conservative (only genuinely tiny/cramped entries) -- everything else stays on 'main' for now, and the Phase 3 collision report shows what (if anything) still needs a manual nudge or a move into this list.
_phase5_balkans_note: Phase 5: moved off the main map into the Europe inset on request -- the main map was dense enough here that these seven were recommended for the inset back in the Phase 3/4 reports. Visit numbers are unchanged; only display location moves.
